evidence.title: MASH-Bench: Diagnosing Cross-Source Failure in Mass-Shooting Risk Classification

summary: Researchers introduce MASH-Bench, a diagnostic tool revealing inconsistencies in AI models assessing mass-shooting risks across different data sources. The benchmark highlights critical reliability gaps in high-stakes predictive systems.
title: New Benchmark MASH-Bench Identifies Cross-Source Failures in Mass-Shooting Risk AI Models
